notes.content: The shadow is described as the lieux refining a figure, with an explicit caution against confusing these with strata that are lieux. The multiombre consists of the strata’s shadows, indexed by the deployment of F. The inclusion relation in the set-theoretic figure is identified with incidence among its strata and with the induced order from M; the author says either ≤ or ≪ gives the same result. A figure is said practically never to reconstruct from its shadow, but often to reconstruct from its multiombre in the case of “Ateliers ensemblistes”. The final unfinished paragraph introduces canonical order relations.
math_reading_decisions: The two order signs and deployment tildes are distinct. The ordinary F after strates has a retraced upper arm, not a further bar or tilde.
The literal spelling déployement and unresolved formé/formée, incidence(s), and de/dans are preserved.
The barred m is transcribed literally; its explanatory expansion appears only in the abbreviation table.
The page supplies assertions rather than a proof. No proof of reconstruction or equivalence of induced relations was attempted.
author_doubts: No explicit authorial doubt or checking request occurs.
“(ou par ≪ au choix, ça revient au [barred m])” asserts equivalence; “Nous y reviendrons.” promises later discussion. Neither is a completed verification.
notes.titles_dates_counts: Manuscript page 6, scan 007. No title, date, archive pencil number, display, diagram, drawing or independent marginal note. Two prose paragraphs, the second unfinished; 22 body lines reported by all three readers. One single underline across two manuscript lines. Four correction regions and one possible earlier a beneath A are represented; the om and a physical states remain uncertain.
